## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Two important problems need fixing. `slugify` matches only ASCII letters and digits, so accented titles lose letters and non-Latin titles produce an empty slug. The PR description also lacks the `## Testing` section that `AGENTS.md` requires. No critical defects were found in the two changed files.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — A title such as `"Café Menu"` becomes `"caf-menu"`, and a title such as `"日本語"` becomes `""`, because the pattern `[^a-z0-9]+` treats every non-ASCII letter as a separator. The PR body says the helper "replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters", but `é` and CJK characters are alphanumeric (`"é".isalnum()` is true) and still get replaced. One fix is to transliterate first: apply `unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", ...)`, drop combining marks, then decide how to handle scripts that still produce an empty slug (for example, raise an error or fall back to a caller-supplied ID). Add test cases for both kinds of input. — Pages with accented titles get wrong URLs. Pages with non-Latin titles get an empty slug, so their URLs collide with each other and with any other empty-slug page.
- PR body — correctness — The PR description has no `## Testing` section. `AGENTS.md:4` says "Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified." The current body has only the one-sentence feature summary. Add a `## Testing` section that says how the change was checked, for example by running `tests/test_slug.py`. — The PR breaks a project contributor rule, and readers cannot tell from the description how the change was verified.

(none)

## Strengths
- Both new modules open with a docstring that states their purpose, as `AGENTS.md:3` requires.
- `tests/test_slug.py` covers collapsing repeated separators, trimming at both ends, input made only of hyphens, and empty input.
